sources.title: Maritime Hunting Culture of Chukotka
sources.note: Smithsonian catalog for a major collaborative study of marine hunting traditions and modern practice.

sources.title: Yaranga and tent
sources.note: Kunstkamera Arctic mobility research on portable dwellings, inner sleeping chambers, lamps, moisture, and maintenance.

sources.title: Mothers and Children among Arctic nomads
sources.note: Kunstkamera field study of present-day Chukchi reindeer-herding camps, child autonomy, observation, play, and work.

sources.title: Food, Family and Work in Amguema
sources.note: Kunstkamera field report on food, kin relations, work, and exchange in a modern Chukotka settlement.

sources.title: Paths of Food in Chukotka
sources.note: Kunstkamera scholarship on movement and distribution of foods across coastal and tundra communities.

sources.title: Traditional diet in coastal Chukotka
sources.note: Peer-reviewed modern study of harvested food, drinking water, household infrastructure, and settlement sanitation.

sources.title: Aboriginal subsistence whaling in Chukotka
sources.note: International Whaling Commission account of coastal community life, whaling, distribution, tools, and inland exchange.

sources.title: Chukotka Heritage Museum ethnographic collection
sources.note: Regional museum description of Indigenous household objects, tools, toys, clothing, transport, ritual material, and provenance.

sources.title: Beringia National Park cultural heritage
sources.note: Regional national park account of living marine hunters, reindeer herders, ancient settlements, and material traces.

sources.title: Chukchi language profile

sources.title: The Chukchi of Northeastern Asia
